messages:
maria: Hey team — I have a few PRs that need review before the cut at 18:00 UTC. Can someone take one?
TL;DR: #4523 (runtime kv-cache edge), #4531 (changelog + docs), #4540 (backport for v1.2). Need approvals, changelog sanity check, and a quick smoke on staging. I’ll watch this thread.

devin: taking #4523 now. running unit tests and a quick smoke locally.

sam: I can pick up #4531 in ~30m. Quick q: changelog prefix format — should we use "fix:" or "bugfix:"?

maria: use conventional short prefixes, e.g. "fix:". Prefer including component tag, e.g.:
```
fix(runtime): avoid kv-cache double-free on short sequences
```

jen: for #4540 (backport) — is this a clean cherry-pick? I can try to backport to release/v1.2 if needed.

devin: tests passed locally for #4523 but left a tiny comment about a missing null-check. once that's in I can approve. pinging @jen for backport readiness.

jen: attempted cherry-pick, hit a conflict in tests. Pushed a WIP branch `backport/4540-v1.2` with the conflict resolved but test still flaky. Can someone run staging smoke: `/deploy staging --tag canary-20260318`?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Request received — staging deploy for tag canary-20260318 by jen. Starting rollout, ETA ~5m.

sam: did a quick smoke on the chat flows and embeddings route — looks good. Noted one flaky tokenizer test in the backport branch, added a comment on the PR.

maria: great, thanks. If we get LGTM on #4523 and #4531 and the backport test stabilized, I’ll tag for the cut. Small changelog copyedit below (one-line).

devin: LGTM on #4523 after I pushed a one-line null-check fix.

sam: LGTM on #4531, fixed a small grammar nit in the changelog entry.

jen: backport branch merged into release/v1.2 with the test fix. @maria you can tag the release.

maria: tagging for cut now. deploy-bot: schedule release-cut v1.2.7 at 18:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: release scheduled: v1.2.7 at 2026-03-18T18:00:00Z. :tada:

maria: thanks everyone — much appreciated. I’ll post a short rollup in #all-hands and update the release notes after the cut.
